resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts and Forest Lookouts date the treated timber R-6 tower to 1959; firelookout.com dates it to 1960. The story gives both.
Idaho Fire Lookouts, Forest Lookouts and the Spokane Historical caption say destroyed in 1975; firelookout.com says removed that year. The story gives both.
The 1944 staff member is spelled Henry Osborn on Idaho Fire Lookouts and Henry Osborne on firelookout.com. The story does not name him.

notes_for_editor: Three listings (firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts, Forest Lookouts) agree on the 1931 platform and the 1933 L-4 tower. Three date the end to 1975 (Idaho Fire Lookouts, Forest Lookouts, Spokane Historical), and firelookout.com says removed that year. Two open points: the second tower's year (1959 vs 1960) and destroyed vs removed. Staff names come from Idaho Fire Lookouts, which credits Kellogg Evening News and the Forest Fire Lookout Page; the 1944 spelling differs between sites. No source states public access, so the access level is left unset; the drive-up listing is the only access statement. Photos on the listings are credited to the Fire Lookout Museum, Pete Miles and the USFS with no licence stated, so none were added.
